preserve.evidence: Seeding pre-renders tiles so they are served from the cache instead of being rendered on demand.
`--zoom` takes a range of zoom levels.

preserve.item: --bbox 생략 시 전체 범위, 전 지구 레이어는 오래 걸림
preserve.evidence: If you omit `--bbox`, the layer's full extent is used, which can take a very long time for global layers.
`geotile seed` uses 4 worker processes by default. Change this with `--workers`.

preserve.item: 600 MB 측정 조건과 벡터 레이어 단서
preserve.evidence: Each worker uses roughly 600 MB of memory, measured on our reference setup (raster layers, 256px tiles, PNG output). Vector layers with many features may use considerably more.
Existing tiles are skipped by default. `--force` overwrites them
it only re-renders tiles inside the bounding box and does not delete tiles outside it.
